title: Captain Toad: Treasure Tracker
description: The repo's second Nintendo 3DS title, and the one that drove most of the PICA200 fragment pipeline — fragment lighting, shadow maps, the chained command buffers and the compressed texture formats. The Studio carries what's decoded for the web so far: the opening stage's diorama, rebuilt from the cartridge's own placement map and model archives, and the HOME Menu banner, a folded three-panel logo standing in front of Toad's tower.
